sentence_stem: Although the data appear to support the hypothesis,
correct_completion: further replication is required before any causal claim can be made.
full_sentence: Although the data appear to support the hypothesis, further replication is required before any causal claim can be made.
acceptable_variants: more research is needed before firm conclusions can be drawn.
the conclusions should be treated as tentative until other studies confirm them.

options.text: the authors can therefore claim with certainty that the treatment causes recovery.
options.why_wrong: Absolute certainty contradicts the hedged tone set up by 'appear to support', and it does not complete the concessive contrast.

options.text: so the hypothesis has been fully proven.
options.why_wrong: 'So' signals consequence, not concession. A fully proven claim does not contrast with data that merely appear supportive.

options.text: further replication is required before any causal claim can be made.
the authors ignored every limitation of their study.
options.why_wrong: This is a negative judgement about the authors and does not follow from a hedged statement of support in the stem.

grammar_focus: Concessive clauses with 'although' and hedged academic qualification
explanation: After 'although', the sentence needs a clause that qualifies the apparent support for the hypothesis, rather than one that overstates or dismisses it.
translation: Veriler hipotezi destekliyormuş gibi görünse de, herhangi bir nedensel iddianın ortaya konabilmesi için daha fazla tekrarlanmış çalışmaya ihtiyaç vardır.
